prompts.original: A stark, desolate military training ground at dawn, conveying a sense of scarcity and decline in national defense. In the foreground, a translucent holographic display projects a clear line graph illustrating the steep numerical decline in 20-year-old male conscription resources from 370,000 in 2015 to below 230,000 in 2025. Faint, ghostly silhouettes of soldiers in uniform march in the distant background, like fading memories of a bygone era. The overall atmosphere is somber, concerned, and reflective, emphasizing a critical national security challenge. Dramatic low-key lighting with long shadows underscores the gravity of the situation.
